name: Cohere Hackathon
prize: $500 (1st), $250 (2nd), $1000 in Cohere credits (3rd). Additionally, individuals from the top three teams may be considered for internship interviews with Cohere.
description: We invite students to come work in teams to design and build MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools to power creative AI use cases! Building on the Cohere workshop on 17 Jan, this hackathon will challenge participants to go beyond standard generative AI and develop tools that can meaningfully augment everyday life, from intelligent schedulers to personalized assistants. Starter code and resources will be provided to all participants.
descriptionBullets: Participants are strongly encouraged to attend the Cohere workshop on 17 January, Saturday from 1PM - 2:30PM EST.
The hacking period will take place from Saturday afternoon to Sunday morning.
Teams of 3-4 will present their final projects to a panel of Cohere judges in a live pitch format on 18 January, Sunday from 10AM - 12PM EST.
The winning designs will be evaluated on creativity, functionality, and innovation.
